description: Catalog browsing and cart tools for the Storefront Assistant — all scoped to the calling visitor's own session, never another visitor's data, and never checkout/payment.

wc_browse_products.reason: Read-only search of the store's own published catalog — the same content any visitor already sees on the shop page. Never returns a draft/pending/private product regardless of arguments passed.

wc_view_cart.reason: Reads only the calling browser's own session cart — the same data the store's own cart page already shows that visitor.

wc_add_to_cart.reason: Mutates only the calling visitor's own session cart — no money moves, no other visitor is affected, and the change is fully reversible via wc_update_cart_item.

wc_update_cart_item.reason: Changes or removes a line in the calling visitor's own session cart — same safety class as wc_add_to_cart.
